# Routes that enter /openapi.json with a path, a method and NO BODY.
#
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. It is the same instrument as
# internal/arch/testdata/turkish_ledger.txt and for the same reason: a debt too
# large to pay in one commit, that must never grow while it is being paid.
#
# TestEveryRealRouteIsDescribed enforces both directions. A route that is
# undescribed and NOT on this list fails the test as new debt. A route that IS
# on this list and has since been described also fails it, because a paid line
# that stays behind quietly forgives the next one.
#
# Measured 2026-09-07, the day core/openapi was published (ADR 0035) and the
# question could be asked at all. Thirty-eight, in two groups that are not the
# same problem.
#
# GROUP 1 — THE COMPONENT NAME CLASH (25 routes)
#
# An OpenAPI component's name is derived from the Go type name, so two modules
# cannot both own a type called Address. Two types wanting one name does not
# degrade one endpoint: Doc.Build FAILS and /openapi.json returns 500 for EVERY
# module. Each module below therefore chose bodiless endpoints over taking the
# whole document down, and each wrote down why — FOUR times, independently, all
# four concluding that the fix is a namespace decision belonging to the core:
#
#   customer/api    addressDTO, addressRequest  vs cart/api      -> "Address"
#   payment/api     collectionDTO               vs product/api   -> "Collection"
#   fulfillment/api optionDTO                   vs product/models-> "Option"
#   order/api       lineItemDTO (via orderDetailDTO) vs cart/api -> "LineItem"
#
# These lines are NOT paid by editing a module. The decision is filed in
# docs/gaps.md section G.
#
# GROUP 2 — NO REASON ON FILE (2 routes)
#
# Nothing anywhere explains these; they are endpoints whose Describe was simply
# never written. What is left is one plugin, and that a PLUGIN is the last
# holdout was its own finding: a plugin brings a module like any other, so
# nothing ever stopped either of them from describing its endpoints — nobody
# did, and nothing could say so.
#
# The first measurement had THIRTEEN here. Five were order after-sales routes,
# and they were worse than unexplained: order/api's Describe godoc named five
# undescribed endpoints under the heading "There is NO other undescribed
# endpoint" while these five sat outside it, added after the sentence was
# written, with nothing in the repository able to contradict it. They were
# described the same day and the sentence was corrected.

# --- group 1: the component name clash ---------------------------------------
# customer addresses ("Address", "AddressRequest")
DELETE /admin/v1/customers/{id}/addresses/{address_id}
DELETE /store/v1/customers/{id}/addresses/{address_id}
GET /admin/v1/customers/{id}/addresses
GET /store/v1/customers/{id}/addresses
POST /admin/v1/customers/{id}/addresses
POST /admin/v1/customers/{id}/addresses/{address_id}/default-billing
POST /admin/v1/customers/{id}/addresses/{address_id}/default-shipping
POST /store/v1/customers/{id}/addresses
POST /store/v1/customers/{id}/addresses/{address_id}/default-billing
POST /store/v1/customers/{id}/addresses/{address_id}/default-shipping
PUT /admin/v1/customers/{id}/addresses/{address_id}
PUT /store/v1/customers/{id}/addresses/{address_id}
# payment collections ("Collection")
GET /admin/v1/payment-collections
GET /admin/v1/payment-collections/{id}
GET /store/v1/payment-collections/{id}
POST /admin/v1/payment-collections
# shipping options ("Option")
GET /admin/v1/shipping-options
GET /admin/v1/shipping-options/{id}
PATCH /admin/v1/shipping-options/{id}
POST /admin/v1/shipping-options
# order detail ("LineItem")
GET /admin/v1/orders/{id}
GET /store/v1/orders/{id}
POST /admin/v1/orders/{id}/archive
POST /admin/v1/orders/{id}/cancel
POST /admin/v1/orders/{id}/complete

# --- group 2: no reason on file ----------------------------------------------
# the search plugin
GET /store/v1/search
POST /admin/v1/search/reindex
